prompt:
Battle arena background for a turn-based tactics game, 1536x1024 landscape (3:2), filling the whole frame edge to edge, no border.

LAYOUT (MOST IMPORTANT): The first attached image is a layout sketch of a 12 x 8 grid of square tiles, each tile 128 x 128 px. Follow it tile for tile:
- light grey tiles = open walkable floor; keep them flat, clean and clearly readable, nothing standing on them.
- big dark squares (a whole tile) = solid TALL blocking objects that fill exactly that tile (walls, containers, pillars, machines, as described below).
- small dark squares in the middle of a tile = LOW cover objects that fill that one tile (bins, crates, barrels, benches, sofas – waist high).
- cyan outlined tiles = hazard floor (described below), clearly visible.
Every object must sit inside its tile(s) and not spill onto neighbouring floor tiles. The floor should be built from large square slabs/plates whose seams line up with the 128 px grid, subtle but readable, so a tactical grid overlay will match the painting. Do NOT draw the grid lines themselves as bright lines and do not copy the grey sketch colours.

CAMERA: straight top-down view (about 80 degrees from horizontal), orthographic, no vanishing point; objects seen mostly from above with only a hint of their front side. Consistent scale: one tile is about one person-width wide.

STYLE: hand-painted cartoon illustration in exactly the painting style of the second attached image (clean dark ink outlines on every shape, soft painterly cel shading, rich but slightly muted colours, no pixel art, no 3D render, no photo). Cyberpunk underground city in the year 2086. Strong value contrast between walkable floor (calm, mid-tone, even) and obstacles (darker, outlined, with cast shadows). Edges of the image may show a little dark surrounding context, but the whole 12 x 8 grid area is the arena.

The attached images are references for layout and painting style ONLY. Do not copy the content of the style image.

STRICT: no people, no figures, no animals, no silhouettes of persons, no readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no signature, no frame, no UI, no grid numbers.

LOCATION: inside the nightclub "High Voltage", a dark underground club. Floor: glossy black tiles; the centre of the room is a dance floor of large square light-up tiles glowing in pink, violet and cyan (each light panel exactly one grid tile).
Top row: a long bar counter of chrome and dark wood with bar stools and bottles behind it (tiles 4-9 of the top row), two concrete pillars wrapped in neon tubes on both ends of the counter.
Bottom: a DJ booth with turntables and a mixing desk (bottom row, columns 6-8), two huge speaker stacks (row 7, columns 5 and 9), dark velvet lounge walls in the bottom corners.
Small squares: small round bar tables with drinks, low velvet stools, a toppled table.
Cyan hazard tiles: two dance floor panels that are broken and sparking with exposed high-voltage cables, crackling lightning.
Lighting: pink and cyan spotlight cones, haze, lightning-bolt neon shapes (symbols only, no letters).
